advanced/klint-editor.title: 🎮 Interactive Editor
advanced/klint-editor.description: The Klint Interactive Editor is the fastest way to learn, experiment, and prototype with Klint. It provides a Monaco-based code editor with live preview, perfect for creative coding and educational purposes.

advanced/web-components.title: Klint Web Components
advanced/web-components.description: Use Klint as a web component in any framework or vanilla HTML.

core-concepts/coordinates.title: Canvas Coordinates
core-concepts/coordinates.description: Understanding the canvas coordinate system is essential for positioning elements correctly in Klint.

core-concepts/klint-context.title: The Klint Context (K)
core-concepts/klint-context.description: The Klint Context, typically named K in the documentation, is the enhanced canvas context that provides all drawing and utility functions. All the functions, patterns and plugins in Klint always reference this context, so you can always use any functions in any situations as long as you can reference it.

core-concepts/lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
core-concepts/lifecycle.description: Understanding Klint's lifecycle is essential for creating efficient canvas animations in React. This document explains how Klint components initialize, update, and render.

core-concepts/react-integration.title: Using Klint with React
core-concepts/react-integration.description: Klint is designed specifically for React, integrating with its component model while carefully avoiding unnecessary re-renders. Understanding this architecture is key to building performant Klint applications.

elements/Color.title: Color
elements/Color.description: The Color element provides comprehensive color utilities, palette management, and color manipulation functions across multiple color spaces.

elements/Easing.title: Easing
elements/Easing.description: The Easing element provides animation easing functions for smooth transitions and motion effects.

elements/State.title: State
elements/State.description: The State element provides persistent state management across animation frames.

elements/Text.title: Text
elements/Text.description: The Text element provides advanced text layout, measurement, and typography features for complex text rendering.

elements/Thing.title: Thing
elements/Thing.description: The Thing element provides utility functions for debugging and development purposes.

elements/Time.title: Timeline
elements/Time.description: The Timeline provides advanced animation sequencing capabilities with keyframe-based animations. Unlike other elements, Timeline is accessed through the useKlint hook for optimal performance.

elements/Vector.title: Vector
elements/Vector.description: The Vector element provides 3D vector mathematics for position, velocity, and force calculations. While designed for 3D operations, it maintains backward compatibility with 2D use cases by defaulting the z-coordinate to 0.

functions/canvas/background.title: background
functions/canvas/background.description: Clears the canvas and sets its background color.

functions/canvas/klintfunctions-canvas.title: Canvas Settings
functions/canvas/klintfunctions-canvas.description: Klint provides functions for configuring canvas behavior and origin settings.

functions/drawing/arc.title: arc
functions/drawing/arc.description: Draws an arc (a portion of a circle) on the canvas.

functions/drawing/circle.title: circle
functions/drawing/circle.description: Draws a circle or an ellipse on the canvas.

functions/drawing/disk.title: disk
functions/drawing/disk.description: Draws a circle or arc with optional sector closing.

functions/drawing/ellipse.title: ellipse
functions/drawing/ellipse.description: Draws an ellipse (oval) on the canvas.

functions/drawing/line.title: line
functions/drawing/line.description: Draws a straight line between two points.

functions/drawing/point.title: point
functions/drawing/point.description: Draws a point (dot) on the canvas.

functions/drawing/polygon.title: polygon
functions/drawing/polygon.description: Draws a regular polygon centered at the specified coordinates.

functions/drawing/rectangle.title: rectangle
functions/drawing/rectangle.description: Draws a rectangle on the canvas.

functions/drawing/roundedRectangle.title: roundedRectangle
functions/drawing/roundedRectangle.description: Draws a rectangle with rounded corners on the canvas.

functions/drawing/strip.title: strip
functions/drawing/strip.description: The Strip element creates strips of triangles, quads, or hulls from arrays of points. Access it via K.Strip on the Klint context.

functions/gradients/addColorStop.title: addColorStop
functions/gradients/addColorStop.description: Adds a color stop to a gradient.

functions/gradients/conicGradient.title: conicGradient
functions/gradients/conicGradient.description: Creates a conic (angular) gradient for fills or strokes.

functions/gradients/gradient.title: gradient
functions/gradients/gradient.description: Creates a linear gradient for fills or strokes.

functions/gradients/radialGradient.title: radialGradient
functions/gradients/radialGradient.description: Creates a radial gradient for fills or strokes.

functions/images/createOffscreen.title: createOffscreen
functions/images/createOffscreen.description: Creates an offscreen canvas for drawing operations outside the main canvas. The best way to think about it is a transparent layer.

functions/images/image.title: image
functions/images/image.description: Draws an image on the canvas. Can crop and resize the source image if needed.

functions/images/klintfunctions-pixels.title: Manipulating Pixels
functions/images/klintfunctions-pixels.description: Klint provides functions for direct pixel access and manipulation.

functions/paths/arcVertex.title: arcVertex
functions/paths/arcVertex.description: Adds an arc segment to the current shape being constructed with beginShape(). Creates a circular arc that connects the current point to a target point with a specified radius.

functions/paths/beginContour.title: beginContour
functions/paths/beginContour.description: Starts a new contour (hole) within the current shape being constructed with beginShape().

functions/paths/beginShape.title: beginShape
functions/paths/beginShape.description: Starts a new custom shape definition.

functions/paths/bezierVertex.title: bezierVertex
functions/paths/bezierVertex.description: Adds a cubic Bézier curve segment to the current shape being constructed with beginShape().

functions/paths/clipTo.title: clipTo
functions/paths/clipTo.description: Creates a clipping region from a path defined in the callback. All subsequent drawing operations will be clipped to this region until the clipping is reset (typically with pop()).

functions/paths/endContour.title: endContour
functions/paths/endContour.description: Ends the current contour (hole) within the shape being constructed with beginShape().

functions/paths/endShape.title: endShape
functions/paths/endShape.description: Completes and renders the current shape being constructed with beginShape().

functions/paths/quadraticVertex.title: quadraticVertex
functions/paths/quadraticVertex.description: Adds a quadratic Bézier curve segment to the current shape being constructed with beginShape().

functions/paths/vertex.title: vertex
functions/paths/vertex.description: Adds a straight line segment to the current shape being constructed with beginShape().

functions/styling/blend.title: blend
functions/styling/blend.description: Sets the blend mode for how new shapes interact with existing content.

functions/styling/fillColor.title: fillColor
functions/styling/fillColor.description: Sets the fill color for shapes and text.

functions/styling/filters.title: Filters
functions/styling/filters.description: Klint provides several filter functions for applying visual effects to drawing operations. Filters are applied to all subsequent drawing until changed or reset.

functions/styling/noFill.title: noFill
functions/styling/noFill.description: Disables filling for shapes and text.

functions/styling/noStroke.title: noStroke
functions/styling/noStroke.description: Disables stroke (outlines) for shapes and text.

functions/styling/opacity.title: opacity
functions/styling/opacity.description: Sets the global alpha (transparency) for all subsequent drawing operations.

functions/styling/strokeCap.title: strokeCap
functions/styling/strokeCap.description: Sets the style of line endpoints.

functions/styling/strokeColor.title: strokeColor
functions/styling/strokeColor.description: Sets the color for lines and shape outlines.

functions/styling/strokeJoin.title: strokeJoin
functions/styling/strokeJoin.description: Sets the style of joints where lines meet.

functions/styling/strokeWidth.title: strokeWidth
functions/styling/strokeWidth.description: Sets the width of lines and shape outlines.

functions/text/klintfunctions-text-styli.title: Styling Text
functions/text/klintfunctions-text-styli.description: Klint provides various functions for styling and rendering text. The 2D canvas API takes the font from the CSS imports, make sure the names are matching.

functions/text/paragraph.title: paragraph
functions/text/paragraph.description: Draws text that automatically wraps to fit within a specified width, creating a paragraph with proper line breaks and justification options.

functions/text/text.title: text
functions/text/text.description: Draws text on the canvas at the specified position. Supports multi-line text using \n line breaks with proper alignment and spacing.

functions/transforms/applyTransform.title: applyTransform
functions/transforms/applyTransform.description: Applies a custom transformation matrix to the current transformation matrix. This is the low-level way to apply transformations using a 2D transformation matrix.

functions/transforms/pop.title: pop
functions/transforms/pop.description: Restores the most recently saved drawing state from the stack.

functions/transforms/push.title: push
functions/transforms/push.description: Saves the current drawing state (transformations, styles, etc.) to the stack. You can think about it as grouping element you want to affect. The transforms will affect all the elements in the groupd undistinctively. The push / pop gets computed alltogether and don't have awareness of what's both what's inside the stack and the transforms applied to it. You won't be able to ping a specific element, to isolate a single element, put it in an another push/pop.

functions/transforms/resetTransform.title: resetTransform
functions/transforms/resetTransform.description: Resets the current transformation matrix to the identity matrix, removing all transformations (translate, rotate, scale) applied to the canvas.

functions/transforms/rotate.title: rotate
functions/transforms/rotate.description: Rotates the coordinate system by the specified angle (in radians). The rotation takes place around the (0,0), use translate() before rotate() to rotate around a different point.

functions/transforms/scale.title: scale
functions/transforms/scale.description: Scales the coordinate system by the specified factors. The scale takes place around the (0,0), use translate() before scale() to rotate around a different point.

functions/transforms/translate.title: translate
functions/transforms/translate.description: Translates (moves) the coordinate system origin by the specified amounts. This is also used to change the origin of transformation for scale, rotation and applyTransform.

functions/utilities/klintfunctions-time.title: Time Management
functions/utilities/klintfunctions-time.description: Klint provides several properties to track and manage time in your animations and interactive sketches. By default, Klint ticks at 60fps, giving you smooth animations while providing different ways to measure and respond to time.

functions/utilities/math-utils.title: Math Utility Functions
functions/utilities/math-utils.description: Klint provides various math functions for common calculations and transformations.

getting-started/installation.title: Installation
getting-started/installation.description: Add Klint to your React project in seconds.

getting-started/quick-start.title: Quick Start
getting-started/quick-start.description: Create your first Klint sketch in 2 minutes. Klint will take the size of its direct parent DOM element.

getting-started/typescript.title: TypeScript Setup
getting-started/typescript.description: Klint is built with TypeScript and provides comprehensive type definitions.

getting-started/useKlint-pattern.title: The useKlint Pattern
getting-started/useKlint-pattern.description: The useKlint hook is the foundation of every Klint sketch. Understanding this pattern is crucial for building with Klint.

introduction.title: Welcome to Klint
introduction.description: Klint is a modern 2D canvas library for React, inspired by p5.js and Processing. It makes creative coding in React intuitive and powerful, perfect for generative art, data visualization, interactive graphics, and creative web experiences.

reference/api-reference.title: API Reference
reference/api-reference.description: Complete reference for all Klint functions, organized by category.

reference/from-p5js.title: Migrating from p5.js
reference/from-p5js.description: If you're coming from p5.js, this guide will help you transition to Klint.

reference/klint-component.title: Klint Component
reference/klint-component.description: The Klint component is the main entry point for rendering canvas graphics in React applications.

reference/klint-hooks.title: Klint Hooks
reference/klint-hooks.description: Klint provides React hooks for managing state, handling input, and loading resources.

reference/troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
reference/troubleshooting.description: Common issues and solutions when working with Klint.
